p: Fonthill Road is known across London for its clothes shops, many of them wholesale and bridalwear, so you'll see shoppers coming from all over to browse along here.

Finsbury Park itself, the big Victorian park, is a few minutes' walk away and hosts some big summer concerts, and Arsenal's Emirates Stadium is close enough that the area fills up on match days, so plan your journey around kick-off. Admiral is an adults-only gaming centre, 18+, so it's not part of a family outing. Seven Sisters Road and Blackstock Road are both packed with cafés and restaurants, with food from all over the world within a short stroll.
